description: We are four eight graders of Instituto CervinoGuaymas Sonora, and we will create a detailed map of Mars using NASA data. Our goal is to help future astronauts explore the planet, find interesting places, and stay safe during their missions. We will combine science, technology, and teamwork to try to make Mars easier to explore!
summary:
Our NASA NOVA team has created an interactive map of the Jezero Crater on Mars, which illustrates the exploration route with a total distance of 48.31 km. The expedition begins from the Perseverance Landing Ellipse, passing through Mineral Terrain and Sediments to the Final Point.

We have created an online presentation that makes use of both the NASA Mars Trek and MOLA elevation data, as well as Genially to make the process interactive.
details:
The project we are presenting to you is an innovative interactive map of the route that can be taken to explore Jezero crater on Mars. The route starts at the Perseverance Landing Ellipse and passes through Mineral Terrain, Sediments, and finally leads to the Final Destination. The total distance of the route is 48.31 km. All the locations can be looked over thoroughly.

One of the advantages of our project is that it makes the surface of Mars more comprehensible and helps people understand how astronauts could perform their job. We hope that the project will raise interest towards the topic of space exploration.

In order to create the project we have used NASA Mars Trek to get the measurements of the distance and create the MOLA layer by means of which we could observe the terrain.

Our idea can be called unique because we have turned the map into the interactive journey. While creating it we thought over the route thoroughly taking into account starting point and the four locations where we want to go.
